name: ChillHouse
kurzbeschreibung: Welcome to ChillHouse in Tirol! Discover the perfect blend of relaxation and adventure in the heart of the Tirol.
beschreibung: In this entry, ChillHouse is listed as a snack bar in Kitzbühel in Tyrol and, according to the description, stands for freshly prepared snacks and local snack culture. However, an unambiguous assignment to a real business was not possible based on official sources: neither the Kitzbühel tourist board nor nationwide directories list a business of this name. Kitzbühel lies in the Tyrolean lowlands, is known as the Gamsstadt and was a Bavarian border and mining town until 1504. The region around Kitzbühel and the Hahnenkamm is among Austria's most important tourism and winter sports areas and offers a wide range of dining, from traditional inns to modern establishments. Details on address, contact and opening hours could not be verified and therefore remain empty.
